sonnet.problem: This true/false card asks about Isaiah 65:6 (whether the LORD will keep silent) before any earlier card in the stop has told verse 6. Story card 13 tells it only afterward. So the choice card jumps ahead and has no setup for the baker to reason from.
sonnet.rule: A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.

sonnet.problem: The question says 'Men won't destroy a cluster of grapes with new wine in it, because it contains a blessing. In the same way...'. That already holds the right answer, 'Not destroy them all', and it rules out the wrong answers. The preceding story card also quotes 'Do not destroy it'.
sonnet.rule: A choice card's question never holds its own answer, or a form of it, like "rock badgers" for "in the rocks." Ask something else.
